thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx / timeouts seen on /v1/generate gateway (us-west). Error rate jumped from ~0.6% to 5.8% in the last 3m. Paging oncall @alex. Automated rollback/route attempts triggered.

alex: oncall ack — digging in. Can someone post the top error class and any recent deploys? :eyes:

maria: I see a large number of KV cache evictions and prefix checksum failures from runtime nodes. Logs show repeated "prefix checksum mismatch" and then immediate eviction loops. No new deploys in the last 45m.

maria: relevant log excerpt:

```
[2026-03-15T12:07:21Z] runtime-45 ERROR KVCache: prefix checksum mismatch id=0x4a3f expected=0x9c1b got=0x2d4e
[2026-03-15T12:07:21Z] runtime-45 WARN KVCache: evicting prefix id=0x4a3f reason=checksum_mismatch
[2026-03-15T12:07:21Z] runtime-45 INFO Prefetcher: scheduled prefetch for prefix=0x4a3f
[2026-03-15T12:07:22Z] gateway-12 WARN request: upstream_timeout code=504 route=/v1/generate
```

maria: summary: prefix KVS is producing inconsistent checksums for a small set of hot prefixes; evictions cause sudden cache missstorms and a spike in backend latency which bubbles up as gateway timeouts/5xx. Seeing repeat attempts to repopulate causing I/O pressure.

devon: +1. I'm seeing the same on runtime metrics: prefix miss rate spiked x12; prefix eviction rate is off the charts on shard group 7. Could be a corruption or a buggy compaction on that shard.

cassie: Support: customer-facing impact — error rates visible to customers on generation requests. Top affected customers: 3 enterprise tenants showing timeouts/502s; some are reporting degraded UX. No P0 escalation yet from customers but NPS impacted.

alex: ok plan: 1) mitigate customer impact (fast fallback), 2) stop the eviction loop, 3) gather a safe snapshot for postmortem. Proposals?

devon: mitigation options:
- toggle prefix-cache to bypass (gateway/runtime flag) to avoid checksum path entirely
- route a fraction of traffic to fallback model pool with independent cache
- increase gateway retries and short-circuit long waits

maria: to stop eviction loop quickly I recommend disabling background prefetch/compaction for shard group 7 and toggling the checksum validation to WARN-only (short term) while we snapshot data. This avoids mass-evictions and lets live traffic work off last-known-good prefixes.

alex: can you run the admin toggles? I'll coordinate routing changes.

devon: running admin calls now — posting commands + responses.

devon: disabling prefix checksum strictness for shard=7

```
$ curl -X POST -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://admin.internal/runtimes/kv/toggle -d '{"shard":7,"checksum_strict":false}'
{"status":"ok","shard":7,"checksum_strict":false}
```

devon: disabling prefetch on shard=7

```
$ curl -X POST https://admin.internal/runtimes/prefetch -d '{"shard":7,"enabled":false}'
{"status":"ok","shard":7,"enabled":false}
```

alex: routing: moving 60% of traffic for /v1/generate -> fallback-pool (cold model variant) and raising gateway retry to 2. Doing gradual shift now.

ops-bot: deploy-router: traffic shift 0% -> 60% to fallback-pool initiated by alex at 2026-03-15T12:16:02Z. Monitoring for errors.

cassie: after initial shift customers 1/3 report fewer timeouts. Observed error rate drop from 5.8% -> 1.9% within 3 minutes.

maria: eviction loop reduced after toggles; shard 7 eviction rate down by ~85%. Some inconsistent prefixes still triggering WARNs but no mass evictions.

devon: gateway 5xx now at 0.8% and trending down. Will keep fallback routing for next 30m while we stabilize.

alex: good. I'm escalating to infra lead for live data verification and snapshot. @maria please take a consistent snapshot of shard 7 and upload to the secure bucket. Also gather RCC (runtime checksums) for last 60m.

maria: snapshot started — ETA ~4m. Using the read-only capture to avoid further writes.

maria: snapshot complete: s3://redwood-postmortem/shard7-snap-1719783456.tar.gz

devon: I've kicked off a background job to run an integrity scanner against the snapshot; results to follow.

ops-bot: monitoring: SLA alert threshold cleared for generation route. Current error rate 0.5% (5m avg). No additional pages since mitigation.

cassie: customers notified via status page update. Posting message to status.redwood:

"We experienced elevated error rates on generation requests due to a KV prefix cache inconsistency. We mitigated by routing traffic to a fallback pool and disabling aggressive cache prefetch on affected shard. Some customers may have experienced timeouts. Engineers are investigating and a follow-up will be posted."

alex: handoff plan: I'm handing to devon for full root-cause and remediation plan. Current status: mitigation successful, snapshot captured, fallback routing active (60%). Next steps for devon: run integrity scan, determine whether to reconstruct or rollback corrupted prefix data, propose long-term fix (compaction fix / checksum invariant), and define rollout for re-enabling prefix-cache.

alex: Handoff details: incident state=mitigated, impact=partial/cust-visible, mitigation=traffic->fallback + checksum_strict=false + prefetch_disabled on shard 7, snapshot=S3 link above. Handoff_time=1719784820. @devon you own the post-incident and follow-up.

devon: acked. I'll open a tracking ticket, include the snapshot + scanner output, and schedule a controlled re-enable in a canary pool once we have a patch. Will update this thread with timeline.

incident-bot: Incident ticket created INC-2026-2456. Severity set to S2. Owners: devon (primary), maria (data capture). Auto-archive: 30d after resolve.

alex: thanks team — good quick coordination. If anything regresses, page immediately. :thumbsup:
